settings.title: Delivery and pickup
settings.subtitle: Pick up your furniture for free at our Longueuil store, or have it delivered to your home. Simple rates, calculated from the store.

settings.pickup_detail: At 1138 Marie-Victorin Blvd. in Longueuil. We call you as soon as your order is ready.
settings.zone_detail: Flat rate for any address within 30 km of our Longueuil store.
settings.beyond_detail: Added to the flat rate for each additional kilometre.
settings.free_text: For a purchase of $3,000 or more, delivery is free within 30 km. Beyond that, only the additional kilometres are charged.

settings.title: Delivery in detail
settings.text: For an exact quote before you order, call us at 450 321-0565.

settings.question: How is the distance calculated?
settings.answer: From our Longueuil store (1138 Marie-Victorin Blvd.) to your address. The first 30 km are included in the flat rate; each kilometre after that is $3.

settings.question: Can you give me an example?
settings.answer:
A $1,500 purchase delivered 50 km from the store: $175 + 20 km × $3 = $235.

The same delivery for a purchase of $3,000 or more: only the 20 additional km, so 20 × $3 = $60.

settings.question: Do you deliver far from Longueuil?
settings.answer: Yes. The rate stays the same: $3 per kilometre beyond the first 30 km. For a home 400 km away, that is 370 additional km.

settings.question: Can I pick up my order myself?
settings.answer: Yes, pickup is free. Choose it at checkout and we'll call you as soon as your order is ready at the store.
